title: [14/10/2025] - Australian zoo layout changes
prompt: The map below shows the changes that have taken place at a zoo in Australia between 1960 and now. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the layout of a zoo in Australia in 1960 and how it has been transformed to the present day.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the zoo has undergone substantial redevelopment, with the most notable changes being the introduction of modern transport infrastructure and a complete reorganization of animal enclosures. While certain recreational facilities have been preserved, the zoo now features enhanced accessibility and a different distribution of animal exhibits.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding the northern section and visitor access, the harbour has been relocated from the top right corner in 1960 to the top left of the site. More significantly, where the seal show once stood in the northeast, there is now a new entrance connected to a ferry terminal at the top center, providing visitors with water-based access to the zoo. Additionally, a second entrance has been established at the bottom center of the site.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the animal enclosures and central facilities, the most dramatic changes have occurred in this area. A new wild animals exhibit has been added to the upper left section, while the Australian animals enclosure has remained in approximately the same location on the western side. The birds and chimpanzees exhibits, which previously occupied the lower-left area, have been removed entirely, and this space is now home to the seal show, which has been moved from its original northeastern position. Furthermore, the African animals enclosure has been relocated from the left side to a more central position, where it now occupies a smaller area. Meanwhile, the gift shop has been retained in the center-right but has undergone renovation, and a cable car system has been installed on the eastern side near the picnic area, which has also been preserved.
